add-comprehensive-email-validation-for-b.head: 5f8a130277dbddc95d133cd2832be639baf89213
add-comprehensive-email-validation-for-b.prTitle: Add comprehensive email validation for blocked users

comentarios.texto: Because `rejectedEmails` is a mutable array on the controller prototype, every instance and modal session shares the same array, so a blocked email from one signup leaks into later attempts and shows an invalid error for unrelated users or after reopening. Move the array creation into `init` so each instance gets its own `Em.A([])`.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.head: 92f44dcea7ff19e9123a30c63c167a2938df5a55
add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.prTitle: Add guest management functionality to existing bookings

comentarios.texto: Catching the error from `sendAddGuestsEmails` and only logging it means guests are persisted but the caller sees a generic success even if all notification emails failed. Surface the failure with a partial-success response or rethrow a `TRPCError` so the UI can warn the user.

The mutation does not check `booking.eventType.seatsPerTimeSlot`, so adding guests can exceed the configured capacity for seated events. Reject the request with a `TRPCError` when `booking.attendees.length + uniqueGuests.length` is greater than `seatsPerTimeSlot`.

add-rolling-updates-feature-flag-and-com.head: 62bf98939eda58f0d0a1a41a58aa6d4ecdc24dba
add-rolling-updates-feature-flag-and-com.prTitle: Add rolling-updates feature flag and compatibility framework

comentarios.texto: Because `Picocli.runReAugmentationIfNeeded` skips `initProfile` for `UpdateCompatibility`, calling `Profile.isFeatureEnabled` can dereference a null current profile and throw `NullPointerException` instead of exiting with the intended disabled-feature code. Switch to `Environment.getCurrentOrCreateFeatureProfile().isFeatureEnabled(Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES)` so a profile is always available for the check.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.prTitle: Enhance embed URL handling and validation system

comentarios.texto: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, `import_remote` passes the URL directly to `open-uri`, which follows redirects, so the host check on the initial URL can be bypassed by a redirect to an internal service such as `169.254.169.254`, leading to SSRF. Fetch the page with a client that disables redirects or re-validates the final URL against `embeddable_host` before reading the body.

feat-add-calendar-cache-status-and-actio.head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
feat-add-calendar-cache-status-and-actio.prTitle: feat: add calendar cache status and actions (#22532)

comentarios.texto: Restricting the lookup to `userId: user.id` rejects team-owned or delegated Google Calendar credentials and does not enforce the same ownership boundary used elsewhere. Allow credentials where `userId` matches the user or the credential's team has a member with that user ID, or reuse the existing credential authorization helper.

feat-upsampling-support-upsampled-error-.head: 71826eb08fc7ea35a5925ad223296feadd5c5e29
feat-upsampling-support-upsampled-error-.prTitle: feat(upsampling) - Support upsampled error count with performance optimizations

comentarios.texto: For every events-stats request, `_are_all_projects_error_upsampled` scans the `issues.client_error_sampling.project_allowlist` list for each queried project ID, so the check scales as O(N×M) as the allowlist grows. Convert the option value into a `set` before the `all(...)` membership test.

fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.head: de628295646d0848226618108a52f2f1e5d04ac0
fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.prTitle: fix: handle collective multiple host on destinationCalendar

comentarios.texto: Using `.find()` deletes only a single old `_calendar` reference, leaving stale events on every other host calendar when rescheduling a collective booking. Switch to `.filter()` and loop over `oldCalendarEvents` to delete each matching reference.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.prTitle: FIX: proper handling of group memberships

comentarios.texto: Adding members performs one `User` query per username, so bulk additions slow linearly with the count. Load all matching users in one query with `User.where(username: usernames.split(","))` before adding them to the group.

oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.prTitle: OAuth credential sync and app integration enhancements

comentarios.texto: Storing the decrypted `reqBody.keys` JSON directly in the credential `key` column without validation means a compromised webhook secret or sync endpoint can write arbitrary JSON into a user's credentials, enabling credential poisoning and unexpected fields that downstream code may trust. Validate the decrypted keys against the target app's credential schema, such as `googleCredentialSchema` or `zoomTokenSchema`, before the update or create and reject payloads that do not match.
